xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4493: Click a pasted image to view it full size, in the composer and in sent messages

plan.title: Click a pasted image to view it full size, in the composer and in sent messages
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A pasted image shows only as a 32x32 composer thumbnail that cannot be clicked, and after send the timeline shows only the @/…/conversation-attachments/<name>/<uuid>.png path. No route reads an attachment back, so the operator cannot view what they pasted.
narratives.Proposal: Add GET /api/conversations/:name/attachments/:file (new route file, images only, realpath containment, 404 on everything else, no-loss matrix row). Add one shared ImageLightbox (store + host in main.tsx). Make the composer thumbnail a button that opens it with the local previewUrl. Parse image attachment references from user message text and render a clickable thumbnail strip beneath the unchanged text. Cover with unit tests, a Playwright spec in a fresh context, and docs in features/conversations.mdx and docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No zoom, pan, rotate, download, or next/previous controls in the lightbox
- No thumbnails for non-image attachments (text, code, PDF); they stay as path text
- The route must never serve a non-image file or read outside the requested conversation's attachments folder
- No route-scopes.ts row for the new route
- No change to upload, delete, cleanup, or retention of attachments
- No rewriting or stripping of the user message text; the path reference stays visible
- No images in assistant messages or tool-call rows
- No edits to src/dashboard/server/routes/conversations.ts and no file-size allowlist raises

autoDecisions.summary: The read route serves image files only (png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp); every other name returns 404.
autoDecisions.rationale: The attachments folder also holds uploaded .html/.js/text/PDF files; serving .html same-origin would execute operator-uploaded script in the dashboard origin. The feature only needs images.

autoDecisions.summary: Every route failure (bad name, traversal, other conversation, non-image, missing, escaping symlink) returns 404; origin failure returns 403.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue AC asks for 404 on any other name; 403 for origin matches every other conversation route.

autoDecisions.summary: No DB lookup in the route; filesystem realpath containment via hasConversationAttachment decides.
autoDecisions.rationale: Folders exist only for real conversations and are cleaned on delete; keeps the route and its test DB-free.

autoDecisions.summary: The route lives in a new file routes/conversation-attachments.ts registered in server.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: routes/conversations.ts sits exactly at its 1072-line file-size allowlist cap; any addition fails npm run lint and agents may not raise the allowlist.

autoDecisions.summary: One shared lightbox using the dialog-host pattern (zustand store + host in main.tsx).
autoDecisions.rationale: conventions.md prescribes it; the timeline is virtualized, so a row-owned overlay would unmount when its row scrolls out.

autoDecisions.summary: Sent messages keep their text unchanged and show a thumbnail strip beneath it (beside, not instead of).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows either; ChatMarkdown already linkifies absolute paths, so replacing the token would fight that renderer and lose the copyable path.

autoDecisions.summary: Thumbnail URLs take the conversation name from the path segment in the message, so UserMessageRow needs no new prop; bare '- /path' (non-Claude harness form) references also match.
autoDecisions.rationale: Handles post-/clear and forked conversations whose transcripts reference a parent's folder, and covers transformMessageForHarness output.

autoDecisions.summary: A thumbnail whose image fails to load renders nothing; the path text remains.
autoDecisions.rationale: Unreferenced attachments are cleaned up; a broken-image icon is noise.

autoDecisions.summary: No route-scopes.ts row; scoped access tokens need admin for the new route.
autoDecisions.rationale: The dashboard page uses the root session and paired devices are admin, so nothing user-facing breaks; widening a scope is a separate security decision.

autoDecisions.summary: The composer closes the lightbox only when the attachment it opened is removed or sent, tracked per composer by attachment id.
autoDecisions.rationale: The preview object URL is revoked at that moment; scoping by owner id stops one mounted composer from closing a lightbox another composer opened.

items.title: Serve conversation image attachments via GET /api/conversations/:name/attachments/:file

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors (lint-file-size reports no growth in routes/conversations.ts)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Add exported resolveConversationImageAttachment(name, file) to services/conversation-attachments.ts (name regex /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/, file regex /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/ and no leading dot, image-extension→content-type map for .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.gif/.webp, hasConversationAttachment realpath containment, realpath + stat isFile). Create routes/conversation-attachments.ts exporting conversationAttachmentRoutes = HttpRouter.add('GET', '/api/conversations/:name/attachments/:file', ...) with validateOrigin (403), decodeURIComponent of both params in try/catch, 404 {error:'Attachment not found'} on every failure, async readFile, HttpServerResponse.uint8Array with contentType and headers X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable. Register it in server.ts Layer.mergeAll after conversationPermissionRoutes. Add a READ row to tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.ts. Do NOT edit routes/conversations.ts (at its 1072-line file-size cap). Unit tests use a temp OVERDECK_HOME with real files, a cross-conversation file, an .html file and an escaping symlink. Test harness: send 200/404 requests with no Origin and no Referer (a GET with neither passes validateOrigin); only the 403 test sends an untrusted Origin. Treat a router no-match failure on decoded traversal paths as 404 (Effect.catch → status 404).

items.title: Given a PNG at conversation-attachments/conv-a/a.png, when GET /api/conversations/conv-a/attachments/a.png is called, then it returns 200 with content-type image/png, x-content-type-options nosniff, and the exact file bytes (named test passes)

Given conv-b/b.png exists, when GET /api/conversations/conv-a/attachments/b.png or the encoded traversals ..%2Fconv-b%2Fb.png and %2E%2E%2Fconv-b%2Fb.png are called, then each returns 404 (named tests pass)

Given conv-a holds page.html and a symlink escape.png pointing outside the folder, when either is requested, then the route returns 404, and a missing nope.png and a conversation name bad.name also return 404 (named tests pass)
Given an Origin header of https://evil.example, when the route is called, then it returns 403 (named test passes)
no-loss-matrix.test.ts passes with a READ row for GET /api/conversations/:name/attachments/:file, and git diff shows no change to src/dashboard/server/routes/conversations.ts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Add exported extractAttachmentImageRefs(text) and AttachmentImageRef {conversationName, file, url} to messagesTimeline/helpers.ts. Regex /\/conversation-attachments\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64})\/([A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.(?:png|jpe?g|gif|webp))(?![A-Za-z0-9._-])/gi; skip files starting with '.'; url = /api/conversations/<encodeURIComponent(name)>/attachments/<encodeURIComponent(file)>; de-duplicate by url, first-seen order. Matches both '@/abs/path' (claude-code) and bare '- /abs/path' (transformMessageForHarness form).

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. New spec modeled on tests/composer-commands.spec.ts with a fixture conversation (id 4493, name image-lightbox-fixture) and every API mocked via page.route: upload-image returns a path under /home/op/.overdeck/conversation-attachments/image-lightbox-fixture/<uuid>.png; **/attachments/* returns a real 1x1 PNG; /message accepts the send; /messages returns a user message whose text is '@<path>' after send. Paste by dispatching a ClipboardEvent('paste') with a DataTransfer holding a PNG File on the contenteditable composer (implementation checkpoint; fallback setInputFiles on input[type=file], noted in a comment). Click 'View pasted.png', assert image-lightbox visible with naturalWidth > 0, Escape closes; reopen, backdrop click at (5,5) closes; send; click the thumbnail in user-message-attachments; assert lightbox img src ends with the attachment file name; Escape closes. Each test uses Playwright's fresh browser context (isolated profile); never attach to another agent's browser.
